description: Renders a specification package as Markdown: the whole package, or the package scoped to one task, with what the task owns in full and everything else by id.

input.description: Exactly one reference to a spec package: a path to its directory or to a file inside it, or a directory name, spec number or spec name under the spec root (16_indexed_code_search, 16, indexed_code_search).

dir.description: the repository the spec root and a relative reference are resolved against

markdown-file.description: also write the Markdown to this file, atomically; relative to the working directory

max-tokens.description: drop detail until the render's estimated tokens fit: first the architecture, then each test's given, when, real components and pseudocode; 0 means no budget

section.description: render only these sections, in the package's order: prd, architecture, requirements, test_spec, tasks; comma-separated or repeated (default: every section)

specs-dir.description: where NN_name packages live; default <dir>/.specs or $AF_SPEC_DIR

task.description: render the package scoped to this task id: what the task owns in full, every other requirement, test and task by id and title; 0 renders the whole package

tool.description: the command that wrote this envelope

ok.description: true only when the command did the whole job it was asked to do; never true beside a non-zero exit_code or an error

status.description: the outcome in words, derived from exit_code: done (0), failed (1) or usage (2)

exit_code.description: the process exit code: 0 done, 1 failed, 2 usage error

summary.description: one sentence on the outcome, at most 200 characters

error.description: what failed and where; present exactly when ok is false

category.description: the kind of failure, which says whether re-running could help; an open set

retryable.description: whether re-running the identical command could succeed

resumable.description: whether re-running the same input continues the work rather than starting it over

fix_hint.description: a mechanical remedy, where one is known

env.description: the environment variables, one of which supplies what is missing

valid.description: the values the flag accepts here

current.description: the flag's value on this run

warnings.description: what went differently than intended without stopping the run

code.description: a stable code naming the cause; an open set

severity.description: high when the result is not quite what it appears to be, low when informational

spec_dir.description: the package directory, relative to --dir when inside it; runnable as specr's input

spec_id.description: the spec id, from the PRD frontmatter

spec_name.description: the spec name, from the PRD frontmatter

title.description: the spec title, from the PRD frontmatter

status.description: the package's lifecycle status: draft, active, sealed, superseded or archived

valid.description: whether the package passes the format's validation; an invalid package still renders in full, and a spec_invalid warning names the failing rules

scope.description: what was rendered: spec (the whole package) or task (the package scoped to one task)

task.description: the task the render is scoped to; present exactly when scope is task

id.description: the task id, as --task takes it

kind.description: implement, or integration for the plan's last task

optional.description: true when the task may be skipped

depends_on.description: the tasks that must be done first

sections.description: the sections the Markdown holds, in order; a subset of prd, architecture, requirements, test_spec, tasks

max_tokens.description: the --max-tokens budget the render was held to; absent when there was none

reduced.description: the detail --max-tokens dropped to fit, in the order it is dropped: architecture (the whole section), test_detail (each test's given, when, real components and pseudocode); absent when nothing was dropped

tokens.description: the estimated token count of markdown (bytes / 4)

tasks.description: every task of the plan, in order: the ids --task takes

id.description: the task id, as --task takes it

kind.description: implement, or integration for the plan's last task

optional.description: true when the task may be skipped

depends_on.description: the tasks that must be done first

markdown_file.description: the absolute path --markdown-file wrote the Markdown to

artifacts.description: what the run produced, read off facts the command holds

kind.description: what the entry is; its other fields are the ones of its kind

dry_run.description: true when it would have been written but for --dry-run

next.description: the invocations a caller would plausibly make next

flags.description: the flags to add, each value its own element

why.description: why a caller would run it

duration_ms.description: wall-clock time of the run, in milliseconds

started_at.description: when the run started, RFC 3339 in UTC

exit_codes.1: failed: the package could not be read, or --markdown-file could not be written; the stage is named in error
exit_codes.2: usage error: the reference names no package or two, an unknown task, or a flag that cannot hold; nothing was read
